title: One Piece Finally Locks In the Biggest Upgrade for Its Most Important Character
content:
With the new chapters released, One Piece continues to dive deeper into the lore of the Elbaph arc, and as the fight grows even more intense and reaches its climax, the heroes are starting to prevail with new tricks up their sleeves. Ever since the emergence of the latest villains, the God’s Knights, the series has made it clear that these villains cannot be taken down with normal tactics. This was confirmed by the Left Hand of the Pirate King, Scopper Gaban, who revealed that these villains require the most special form of Haki: Conqueror’s Haki, which was able to land a fatal attack on one of the God’s Knights.

However, Gaban alone wouldn’t be able to take on all the God’s Knights, and this is where the main heroes, the Straw Hats , have emerged, with Zoro and Sanji being the candidates to take on the God’s Knights, Sommers and Killingham. While the show is yet to showcase how Sanji is going to approach this battle, it was already made clear that Zoro would be mastering Conqueror’s Haki, as the Straw Hat has already been shown to possess it but has never actually been able to consciously use it. It became evident that he possessed this Haki during the Wano arc, but now, in the latest chapter, Zoro has seemingly mastered it in the coolest way possible.

One Piece Finally Solidifies the Coolest Straw Hat’s Most Important Upgrade

One Piece chapter 1193 started with Zoro confronting Sommers and beginning to think about how exactly he should use this necessary power to defeat him. Zoro makes it clear even to Sommers that he can use Conqueror’s Haki and that he will be defeated once Zoro masters it. Now, the latest chapter, 1194, sees him pondering more about this power and how to consciously use it. As he tries multiple strategies, all of them fail because Zoro cannot infuse it into his sword. However, Zoro recalls his teacher’s notes about what makes the Supreme King’s Haki so different from other types of Haki, and it is revealed to be a “sense of self.”

This is a perfect explanation for Conqueror’s Haki, as those who do not possess it and lack strong Haki begin to lose their sense of self, which is hinted at by how many people literally lose consciousness in the presence of the Haki. With this revelation becoming clear to Zoro, he wraps the cloth around his head, entering his iconic fighting state, and infuses himself and his sword with Conqueror’s Haki, making Sommers visibly terrified that Zoro has indeed mastered it. On a deeper level, it was always inevitable that Zoro would master it soon.

Zoro has already been known to use it against Kaido and defeat King with this power, albeit unconsciously. With the right circumstances presenting themselves again, it was clear that Zoro would use it again, and his encounter with Sommers was exactly that. Zoro has yet again proved that he is one of the most important and coolest characters in One Piece . With his latest and much-needed power upgrade, fans will get to see a new Zoro emerge yet again, as he could actually become the first Straw Hat to take down a God’s Knight, locking in another achievement as a Straw Hat in One Piece that others, even Luffy, won’t be able to match, all because of Zoro’s cool factor that has no parallel.

title: Voice Actress Asami Yaguchi Dies at 47
content:
Talent agency Kenyū Office announced on Monday that voice actress Asami Yaguchi died suddenly on Saturday. She was 47. A private funeral service with only close relatives in attendance is being held in accordance with the family's wishes.

Oricon News reported that the agency stated that Yaguchi "passed away suddenly due to heart failure," but the agency's obituary announcement did not state the cause of death.

The agency's staff stated in the announcement that Yaguchi has supported the company from its early days, and described her as cheerful, great at taking care of other people, and a big favorite of late voice actor Kazuya Tatekabe .

Yaguchi was born on July 31, 1979 in Saitama Prefecture, and she made her professional debut in 2002. She voiced Kuchipatchi in the 2007 Let's Go! Tamagotchi anime series and Tamagotchi the Movie . She reprised the role in the 2009 Tamagotchi! television anime series, and its sequel Tamagotchi! Yume Kira Dream in 2012, and Tamagotchi! Miracle Friends in 2013. Yaguchi also voiced Katina Tarask in Super Robot Wars OG: Divine Wars and Super Robot Wars OG: The Inspector , Tarlant in Fantastic Children , Eleonore Von Wittenburg in Dies irae , and Gintoki Sakata (during childhood) in the Gintama series.

Yaguchi voiced the characters Katina Tarask and Eleonore Von Wittenburg in the video games Super Robot Wars Original Generations and Dies irae 〜Interview with Kaziklu Bey〜 , respectively. She also voiced Pith in the Arknights game, and Young Eliwood in Fire Emblem Heroes .

title: Dungeon Friends Forever Manga Ends With 8th Volume
content:
Seven Seas Entertainment publishes the manga physically and digitally, and describes the story:

A charming fantasy rom-com about a human adventurer and his childhood friend, the dragon girl boss of a dungeon! Van the warrior and Ryuka the dragon have been friends since childhood. As adults, Van is now a dashing adventurer, and Ryuka has become the big boss of a dangerous dungeon! Every time Van wants to hang out with his old friend, he must navigate a dungeon and clobber a coterie of Ryuka's monster underlings. Will their friendship grow into something more?

Kuma launched the manga in Kadokawa 's Monthly Comic Alive magazine in January 2022. Kadokawa published the manga's seventh volume in November 2025. Seven Seas will publish the seventh volume physically in English on October 27.

title: Battle Royale: Enforcers Artist Yukai Asada Launches New Manga
content:
Hero's Inc. 's HERO'S Web announced on September 16 Battle Royale: Enforcers artist Yukai Asada will launch a new manga titled Zombie Dakedo Shitsumon Aru? (I'm a Zombie, Any Questions?) on the platform on September 29.

The manga is set in a post-apocalyptic Japan after a lifespan-extending drug causes a zombie epidemic. In this landscape, high school student Mina and breakdancing-vlogger-turned-half-zombie Haru begin their desperate fight to escape.

Asada launched the Battle Royale III: Enforcers manga based on Koushun Takami 's Battle Royale franchise in Akita Shoten 's Bessatsu Young Champion magazine in February 2022. Akita Publishing shipped the fifth compiled book volume in June 2025. Viz Media publishes the series in English and shipped the fifth volume on May 19.

title: Though I Am an Inept Villainess Anime Reveals Epilogue Visual
content:
Though I Am an Inept Villainess anime revealed an epilogue visual featuring the main characters Kou Reirin and Shu Keigetsu. A second cour has been confirmed to premiere in January 2027.

The plot synopsis for the upcoming cour is as follows: Through Reirin and Keigetsu’s actions, the series of disturbances caused by a curse in the inner court has settled down. Through their swap, Reirin and Keigetsu learned about each other’s character, and a friendship began to bud between them. Seasons pass, and we are now in early autumn. The ritual where the Crown Prince and the Maidens wish for a bountiful harvest (the Harvest Festival) has been set in the southern lands ruled by the Shu clan. With no consort as guardian, Keigetsu continues preparations despite the pressure of hosting the Harvest Festival. Meanwhile, Reirin wholeheartedly supports Keigetsu while being thrilled about her first royal outing.

However, right upon arrival, an unforeseen accident occurs, and the ritual is interrupted. An agitated Keigetsu’s spell runs out of control, and she once again swaps bodies with Reirin. On top of that, amid all the confusion, the post-swap Reirin is abducted…!?

Reirin’s two overprotective brothers, Kou Keikou and Kou Keishou, get involved, and the situation takes an unexpected turn. Who is the new mastermind sneaking in to frame Keigetsu…? The gratifying tale of switched fates brought to you by two girls who are opposites—the curtain rises on the second act, “The First Royal Outing” Arc!

Mitsue Yamazaki is directing the anime at studio Doga Kobo. Yoshiko Nakamura is in charge of the series composition while Ai Kikuchi is illustrating character designs. Manaka Iwami voices Kou Reirin and Natsumi Kawaida plays the role of Shu Keigetsu.

The anime is based on a light novel series by Satsuki Nakamura. It was first published online on the Shosetsuka ni Naro website in July 2020. Ichijinsha released the print edition featuring illustrations by YukiKana in December 2020. Around the same time, a manga adaptation illustrated by Ei Ohitsuji began serialization in Monthly Comic Zero Sum. title: Synduality Echo of Ada Game to End Online Service in 2027
content:
Bandai Namco Europe announced on Monday that Bandai Namco Entertainment 's Synduality Echo of Ada game will end its online service after May 2027, and will transition to an offline version.

With the end of the online service, updates and events will no longer be available after the content scheduled for October.

Sales of in-game items including the "SYN COINS" tokens will end on December 18. The launch of the transfer of save data to local save data is also scheduled for December. The end date of the online service is scheduled to be announced in March 2027, and transition to the offline game is scheduled after May 2027.

The game launched on January 24, 2025 (January 23 in Japan) for PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC via Steam .

Sony describes the game:

The year is 2222. It has been years since Tears of the New Moon, a mysterious rain, poured and wiped out almost the entire human race. The poisonous rain gave birth to deformed creatures devouring for humans, and humanity fled from the danger. As means for survival, the humans then build an underground haven; Amasia. In this new built dystopian city, on a pursuit of maintaining their existence, they run into an Artificial Intelligence named Magus. Not knowing how things will work between them, the story of how Humans and AI coinciding and trying to find their truths begin.

The game is part of Bandai Namco Filmworks and Bandai Spirits ' Synduality project, which includes the television anime Synduality: Noir . The anime's first cours premiered in July 2023. Disney+ streamed the anime exclusively worldwide as it aired in Japan. Hulu streamed the anime in the U.S. The second cours (quarter of a year) premiered on the TV Tokyo , TV Osaka , TV Aichi , TV Setouchi , TV Hokkaido , and TV Q Kyuushuu channels in January 2024. Disney+ exclusively streamed the second cours starting a day later in Japan.

While the game is set in the year 2222, the anime is set 20 years after in 2242.

The franchise also has a manga spinoff titled Synduality: Ellie , focusing on the titular character, which launched in Kadokawa 's Monthly Comic Alive magazine in July 2023. The second and final compiled book volume shipped in Japan in January 2025. Hiroshi Mishima drew the manga. The manga also has a novelization under Kadokawa 's MF Bunko J label.

The franchise also has a separate novel spinoff "photo story" titled Synduality: Kaleido , which launched in Hobby Japan 's Monthly Hobby Japan magazine in July 2023.

title: Everyone's Darling Has a Secret Gets Anime
content:
Everyone’s Darling Has a Secret manga is getting an anime series. A visual was revealed, along with the main staff and cast, and an April 2027 release date. Studio Gekko is animating the series.

The voice cast consists of:

• Reiji Kawashima as Hizashi Hiruno

• Hikaru Tono as Rei Kuromiya

• Iori Noguchi as Sakura Akai

• Ami Maeshima as Sora Konno

Hikaru Sato is directing the anime with Fumihiko Shimo in charge of the series scripts. Kibidango 14-go is the character designer, while Satoru Kosaki and MONACA compose the music.

Kashiko Amane writes and illustrates the manga that the anime is based on. Hakusensha is publishing the manga since September 2022. Yen Press is licensing it in English, describing the plot as follows: Hizashi Hiruno, a freshman at a super-elite high school, has just finished his first academic proficiency test of the year. He anxiously awaits the results, which will set the tone for his next three years at school. But due to a mistake on his answer sheet, he receives an abysmal score and gets sent to remedial lessons! If there’s one silver lining, he’s not the only one—and his comrade could be the girl of his dreams?! title: Machibari, Juan Albarrán Each Launch New Manga on Manga One App
content:
Shogakukan 's Manga ONE app announced on Monday its new autumn serializations, which include new series by Machibari and Juan Albarrán .

Writer Machibari and artist Seseri's Mibun ga Gyakuten Itashimashite ( Somehow, Our Roles Were Reversed ) manga will launch on October 17. Itoko is credited with the character designs.

Spanish artist Juan Albarrán and Kо̄ta Matsuda will launch the Kyokuhoku Tengoku: Escape From The Far North (The Heavenly Prison of The Far North) manga on October 25.

Albarrán ended the Mangaka's Road to Japan manga on February 13. The manga launched on Comic Days in October 2025 with an English simulpub on Kodansha 's K MANGA service .

Albarrán is the artist for the Matagi Gunner manga. Shōji Fujimoto wrote the manga's story. The manga launched in Kodansha 's Morning magazine in 2022, and ended in its 11th and final compiled book volume, which shipped in June 2025.

Machibari 's Yomei Wazuka Dakara to Tsuihō Sareta Seijo Desu ga, Junrei no Tabi ni Detara Chō Kenkō ni Narimashita ( The Banished Saint's Pilgrimage: From Dying to Thriving ) and Kenka Bakaridatta Konyakusha ga Ikinari Dekiai Shite Kimasu ( All My Fiancé and I Did Was Fight, But Now He's All Over Me? ) novels have previously received manga adaptations. Square Enix 's Manga UP! Global service publishes Komugi Awaya 's adaptation of The Banished Saint's Pilgrimage: From Dying to Thriving , and Shusuisha publishes Makoto Ayase 's manga adaptation of All My Fiancé and I Did Was Fight, But Now He's All Over Me? in English digitally.

title: Lone Wolf and Cub Deluxe Edition Manga Wins Ringo Award
content:
The first volume of the Deluxe Edition of the manga shipped on December 9.

The original manga centers on Ogami Ittō, who is an executioner for the Shogun. After he is framed and his wife murdered, he and his infant son Daigorō wander the country as assassins for hire, while also working toward their own revenge.

Koike and Kojima original serialized the manga from 1970-1976. Kojima died in 2000 and Koike died in 2019.

First Comics premiered the manga in English in May 1987. The series was one of the first manga published in North America, and the first manga to be released in North America on a monthly schedule. Dark Horse Comics began releasing the series in 2000 as the first manga series to be published in North America straight to graphic novels that corresponded with the Japanese releases. In 2013, Dark Horse began releasing the series in omnibus format. In 2017, the company announced a Gallery Edition reprint that was released in a single volume in July 2018.

The manga inspired six feature movies starring Tomisaburō Wakayama , four stage plays, and a television series. As of October 2017, Paramount had the rights to a separate English-language live-action film adaptation of the manga.

Dark Horse Comics has also released the New Lone Wolf & Cub sequel manga and the Western comic series Lone Wolf 2100 .

The manga recently inspired a kabuki stage play adaptation that ran at Kabukiza Theatre in Tokyo from June 3-25.

The Ringo Awards, named after the late comic artist Mike Wieringo, recognize achievements across the comic book industry, with categories ranging from Best Cartoonist and Best Series to Best Original Graphic Novel and Best Webcomic. Both fans and professionals choose the nominations, and final voting is limited to professionals working in the comics field. The the awards ceremony itself is open to both fans and industry members. 2026 marked the 10th annual awards.

Dark Horse Comics has also released the New Lone Wolf & Cub sequel manga and the Western comic series Lone Wolf 2100 .
The manga recently inspired a kabuki stage play adaptation that ran at Kabukiza Theatre in Tokyo from June 3-25.

The Ringo Awards, named after the late comic artist Mike Wieringo, recognize achievements across the comic book industry, with categories ranging from Best Cartoonist and Best Series to Best Original Graphic Novel and Best Webcomic. Both fans and professionals choose the nominations, and final voting is limited to professionals working in the comics field. The the awards ceremony itself is open to both fans and industry members. 2026 marked the 10th annual awards.

title: Zero-sen Hayato Anime Scriptwriter Sō Kuramoto Dies at 91
content:
The official website of screenwriter Sō Kuramoto 's foundation Kuramoto Sō Kaiwai announced on Monday that he died on September 18 due to multiple organ failure. He was 91.

A private funeral service with only close relatives in attendance was held in accordance with the family's wishes. A memorial service will be held on November 3 at the Furano Theatre Factory in Hokkaido. More details of the memorial service will be revealed at a later date.

Screenwriter, playwright, and director Kuramoto (real name Kaoru Yamaya) was born in Tokyo in 1935. He joined Nippon Broadcasting System in 1959, after graduating from University of Tokyo . After leaving the company in 1963, he became an independent screenwriter, and started using the pen name Sō Kuramoto .

His notable works include the original story of the 1975 drama series Zenryaku Ofukuro-sama (Dear Mother), screenplay of the 1980 drama series Sayonara Oryū-san (Goodbye, Oryū-san), and original story and screenplay of the drama series Kita no Kuni kara (From the North Country), which aired from 1981 to 1982, among others. Kuramoto also wrote the screenplay for the 2024 film Umi no Chinmoku (The Silence of the Sea), which had been in development for 60 years.

In anime, Kuramoto wrote the script for the 1964 series Zero-sen Hayato , along with Akira Kōno and Tomio Sagisu .
